label: preparing
what: A coordinated gathering at the town hall at eighteen on day 1, involving eight installed lanterns and a discreet order for 200 fresh loaves, presented to me as a lighting review. Builder coordinates and accepts the 101-emerald bread debt; baker, innkeeper and freight supply or arrange bread. Secretary knowingly helps coordinate appointments and clarify payment, though knowledge of any concealed purpose is uncertain. It may celebrate my forty years as mayor, but that purpose remains speculation, not confirmed.
